adjudication.rationale: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/organizations/create.handler.ts the conditionals for setting the organization slug were changed from `...(!IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { slug })` and `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED && { requestedSlug: slug })` to `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { slug } : {})` and `...(IS_TEAM_BILLING_ENABLED ? { requestedSlug: slug } : {})`. This means when billing is disabled, neither `slug` nor `metadata.requestedSlug` is set at all (regression vs previous behavior that set `slug`), and when billing is enabled it now sets `slug` at creation time (previously only `requestedSlug`), which would claim the slug immediately rather than gating it behind billing flow.
